name: Farnese Atlas
original_name: ファルネーゼ・アトラス
source:
Etoile's childhood friend and self proclaimed "Witch of Justice". She loves Etoile with all of her heart. She has a familiar dog named Ciel whom always seen together with her.

[spoiler]Witch of Taurus Constellation.[/spoiler]
